title: EsSA truck mechanic repaired damaged suspensions

tellings.quote: I have a really interesting point that I want to make quickly because I just talked to allegedly the mechanic who worked on the trucks >> that this was the mechanic for the trucks as a military base and he said that he had to make all these extensive repairs on the suspension at that time

plain: In 1996 the trucks at a Brazilian army school for sergeants, known as EsSA, needed major repairs to their suspensions, according to a man said to have been the base's truck mechanic. The documentary filmmaker James Fox says he had just spoken to this man, and he passes the account on. Fox raises it because damaged suspensions would suggest the trucks had carried something unusually heavy at that time.
